alkylation reagent: 400 mM 2-chloroacetamide (Sigma) was added at 1:10 ratio to the samples.
alkylation concentration: 400 mM 2-chloroacetamide (Sigma) was added at 1:10 ratio to the samples.
cleavage agent: Samples were digested with MS-grade trypsin (Worthington Biochemical) at 1:20 wt:wt in 50 mM TEAB for 15 h at 37 °C.
collision energy: MS2 was acquired at resolution of 60,000, AGC target of 2e5 with max fill time set at 200 ms, stepped HCD of 28, 33, and 55, isolation width set at 0.7 m/z.
enrichment method: S-trap digested samples were resuspended in 1 ml of 1× Immunoaffinity Purification (IAP) bind buffer following the protocol outlined in the PTMScan HS Ubiquitin/SUMO remnant kit (#59322, Cell Signaling Technologies).
fragmentation method: MS2 was acquired at resolution of 60,000, AGC target of 2e5 with max fill time set at 200 ms, stepped HCD of 28, 33, and 55, isolation width set at 0.7 m/z.
instrument: TMTpro labeled K-ε-GG enriched samples were analyzed on Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer with FAIMS (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: The beads were resuspended in 200 μl of 100 mM HEPES, pH 8.5 for on-bead TMTpro (Thermo Fisher Scientific) labeling.
precursor tolerance: Both spectral recalibration and main searches utilized a Uniprot.fasta database of reviewed human proteins (SwissProt, downloaded March 8, 2018 with 25,889 entries) using the Sequest HT node with the following settings: fully specific trypsin, max missed cleavage sites of 2, minimum peptide length of 6, MS1 mass tolerance of 10 ppm, MS2 mass tolerance of 0.02 Da
fragment tolerance: Both spectral recalibration and main searches utilized a Uniprot.fasta database of reviewed human proteins (SwissProt, downloaded March 8, 2018 with 25,889 entries) using the Sequest HT node with the following settings: fully specific trypsin, max missed cleavage sites of 2, minimum peptide length of 6, MS1 mass tolerance of 10 ppm, MS2 mass tolerance of 0.02 Da
ptm: dynamic GG modification on lysine; static peptide N-terminal modification of TMTpro on any N-terminus; static carbamidomethylation on cysteine; dynamic modification of peptide for methionine oxidation; lysine diglycine (i.e., ubiquitin remnant); lysine TMTpro; dynamic modification of protein N-terminus for acetylation; loss of methionine; loss of methionine coupled with acetylation

Spectral recalibration and main search functions utilized fully specific trypsin cleavage, with dynamic GG modification on lysine, static peptide N-terminal modification of TMTpro on any N-terminus, and static carbamidomethylation on cysteine. Both spectral recalibration and main searches utilized a Uniprot.fasta database of reviewed human proteins (SwissProt, downloaded March 8, 2018 with 25,889 entries) using the Sequest HT node with the following settings: fully specific trypsin, max missed cleavage sites of 2, minimum peptide length of 6, MS1 mass tolerance of 10 ppm, MS2 mass tolerance of 0.02 Da, static modifications of peptide N-terminus for TMTpro and cysteine carbamidomethyl, dynamic modification of peptide for methionine oxidation, lysine diglycine (i.e., ubiquitin remnant) and lysine TMTpro; dynamic modification of protein N-terminus for acetylation, loss of methionine, and loss of methionine coupled with acetylation.
reduction reagent: 5% SDS, 100 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (Fisher), 400 mM 2-chloroacetamide (Sigma) was added at 1:10 ratio to the samples.
